_readme: Functions exported from functions/src but intentionally NOT deployed. Each entry needs name, reason and addedOn (YYYY-MM-DD). check-deploy-drift.mjs fails on a malformed entry, one older than 60 days, a name that is no longer exported, or a name that is now deployed. See scripts/lib/driftAllowlist.mjs. A withheld function must ALSO stay out of functions/src/index.ts (Firebase deploys exactly what index.ts exports); functions/src/__tests__/withheldFunctions.test.ts fails if one is re-exported there.

functionsNotDeployed.name: resolveCommunityInvite
functionsNotDeployed.reason: Public, unauthenticated invite resolver. Deleted from production 2026-11-21 and withheld from functions/src/index.ts so a full deploy cannot ship it; nothing in the app, hosting or landing page calls it. Re-export it (communities section of index.ts) in the web landing task, with its IP rate key verified, and remove this entry.

functionsNotDeployed.name: callClaude
functionsNotDeployed.reason: Authenticated endpoint spending the platform's Anthropic key. Deleted from production 2026-11-21 and withheld from functions/src/index.ts so a full deploy cannot ship it: the hooks that call it (useGenerateTitle, useAiCrewSuggestion, useAiCrewRecommendation) are imported by no screen, so it has zero legitimate callers. Re-export it (index.ts) in the same change that ships the UI, and remove this entry.

functionsNotDeployed.name: paymentWebhook
functionsNotDeployed.reason: Public provider callback. Deleted from production 2026-11-21 and withheld from functions/src/payments/index.ts so a full deploy cannot ship it: nothing calls it (paymentProvider is grow_link, which settles through paymentLinkConfirm; getWebhookProvider returns null for it). Re-export it in payments/index.ts with the Grow webhook step (with its GROW_* secrets), and remove this entry.
